product_one_liner.value: Rasayel gives B2B sales teams a WhatsApp platform to manage conversations, automate follow-ups, and sync customer chats with their CRM.
product_one_liner.notes: Rasayel’s homepage describes a WhatsApp platform trusted by sales teams and says it tracks conversations, automates follow-ups, and syncs WhatsApp with CRM systems.

pricing_page.notes: Rasayel has a public pricing page with Start and Grow plans and per-user monthly prices, so a public pricing page exists.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: Rasayel’s success-stories index includes a Casita case study and a Factorial case study, identifying both as customers. | named_customers.0: The success-stories index names Casita in a customer case-study title and summary. | named_customers.1: The success-stories index names Factorial in a customer case-study title and summary.

employee_band.notes: PitchBook lists 17 employees as of 2026-05-29, which falls in the 11-20 band.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The headquarters entry explicitly names Cork as the city; a Viber partner listing also places Rasayel in Cork. | hq_country: Craft identifies Rasayel’s headquarters as Cork, Ireland, and the Viber messaging-partner listing independently gives Rasayel’s location as Cork, Ireland.

founded_year.notes: Seedcamp lists Rasayel as founded in 2022, and a company profile says it was co-founded in February 2022. PitchBook gives a conflicting 2020 year, so 2022 is the best-supported answer but the conflict lowers confidence.

eng_blog.notes: The full visible blog index consists of WhatsApp sales/marketing and customer-support guides and customer success stories, not engineering or technical posts by engineers; it does not meet the two-post threshold.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index contains multiple setup, inbox, WhatsApp Business, automation, and integration articles, meeting the requirement for several public docs.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page’s open-jobs list contains only a Senior Software Engineer title, not an AI, ML, or data-science title.

model_provider.notes: The AI documentation describes the assistant and its knowledge-base behavior but does not identify a model provider; a recent review of Rasayel’s published materials likewise says no model/provider is named. The privacy page’s disclosed-data section provides no AI model subprocessor name.

compliance_certs.notes: Rasayel’s security policy is the relevant trust/security page; its full contents describe controls but do not name SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as Rasayel certifications.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Wellfound and PitchBook both identify the known round as Seed. A separate apparent October 2026 Rasayel round is associated with rasayel.com and Dubai, not the requested rasayel.io company. | funding_date: The funding profile dates the Seed round to February 2022, and PitchBook gives the deal date as 2022-02-01; the requested YYYY-MM value is 2022-02. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile describes the Seed round amount as undisclosed, and the PitchBook deal table supplies no amount; a numeric amount is therefore unknown.

raised_18mo.notes: The supported round for Rasayel.io is the February 2022 Seed round, outside the 18-month window ending 2026-11-09. The reported October 2026 $10M Series A names rasayel.com and Dubai, identifying a different same-name company.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current careers listing shows one open role, Senior Software Engineer, and no SDR, BDR, or account-executive role.

launched_6mo.notes: The changelog’s newest dated items are April 28 and April 5, 2026, both before the six-month window beginning 2026-05-09; no newer launch-type entry appears on the changelog.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The current, compact team page lists Tarek Khalil as CEO and co-founder and Mohamed Elbadwihi as COO and co-founder, with no other C-level or VP-level role in the team listing. No within-window leadership join or departure announcement was found; the team page supports a negative answer with some uncertainty because it does not provide join dates.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: Rasayel’s public integrations documentation lists HubSpot, Salesforce, Zapier, Pipedrive, and Zoho as integrations. | crm_stack_signal.0: The integrations index explicitly lists HubSpot. | crm_stack_signal.1: The integrations index explicitly lists Salesforce. | crm_stack_signal.2: The integrations index explicitly lists Zapier. | crm_stack_signal.3: The integrations index explicitly lists Pipedrive. | crm_stack_signal.4: The integrations index explicitly lists Zoho.
